title: Peraso Shrinks the Hardware Behind Faster Drone Comms
summary: A new lightweight module from Peraso Inc. could help drones move more data without adding significant weight to their communications hardware. The PRM2145 uses the company’s 60-gigahertz millimeter-wave (mmWave) technology to deliver secure, low-latency communications while keeping power consumption and weight requirements low.
